# Investment Memorandum: Box, Inc. Credit Amendment

## Executive Summary

**Date of Agreement:** December 19, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Box, Inc., a Delaware corporation, specializing in cloud content management and collaboration solutions.

**Transaction Description:** Amendment No. 1 to Amended and Restated Credit Agreement between Box, Inc. (Borrower) and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (Lender). This amendment modifies the existing credit agreement originally dated June 30, 2023.

**Purpose of Financing:** N/A - The document does not specify the purpose of the financing or amendment.

**Company Background:** Box, Inc. is a Delaware corporation with Dylan Smith serving as Chief Financial Officer. The company maintains an existing credit relationship with Wells Fargo Bank established in June 2023.

## Investment Highlights & Risks

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Established banking relationship with Wells Fargo since June 2023
• Substantial credit facility size of $75 million commitment
• Security package includes guarantees, pledges, and security interests that remain in full force
• No existing events of default or potential events of default per borrower representations
• Comprehensive covenant structure with financial maintenance requirements

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• Limited financial performance data available in amendment document
• Reference to "Liquidity Condition" covenant suggests potential liquidity monitoring requirements
• Mitigating factor: Comprehensive security package and guarantees remain intact
• Mitigating factor: No current defaults reported and all representations and warranties reaffirmed
